node.title: Re: How to execute a linux system command with perl?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: You haven't shown any error messages, so we can't say what's going wrong. (Also, please use tags to format code.) It looks like you're not checking the return value of [doc://system] for errors, you should do that with the code shown in its documentation, or with a module such as [mod://IPC::System::Simple]. I wrote about the topic of running external commands at length, with sample code, [id://1180578|here].
